fieldData.description:
Radix SA is the South African group for existing and potential fans of this potentially revolutionary technology. Join us on telegram at t.me/radixsa. Radix SA will be hosting their first meetup and wants you to come join. At the meetup you can: - learn more about what Radix is and the unique features it brings to the crypto space
- meet existing and new Radix fans and learn why they are so excited about Radix
- find people to collaborate with on projects
- enjoy free drinks and snacks and get your own Radix t-shirt (only if you reply in advance) This meetup is for:
- anyone wanting to learn more about the crypto world and the problems it needs to solve to become mainstream
- anyone interested or already investing in crypto currencies
- anyone interested or already developing on crypto networks
fieldData.location: The Slug & Lettuce - Century City Century Way G11 Colosseum Building, Century City Cape Town, WC 7441 South Africa
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - Cape Town
